purpose: Say that one thing does not reach another thing’s degree.
keywords: Comparison noun + ほど + negative predicate
Today is not as cold as yesterday.
This road is not as crowded as the main road.
I cannot swim as fast as my older sister.
formation: Comparison noun + ほど + negative predicate
restrictions: A negative predicate is needed for the less-than comparison.
mistake: AはBほど〜ない means A is less so than B, not the reverse.
